title: call-stack-flipbook-elsa-2026-08-22
content:
Date: 2026-08-22
Context: heavy focus on net-new accounts from trial import. Goal: 12 touch attempts today (calls + VMs + 2 follow up emails). Primary KPI: 3 qualified meetings, 1 demo scheduled.

MORNING PRIORITIES (30m):
- 09:00: triage CRM list (remove duplicates, confirm timezone)
- 09:15: prioritize > ARR 50k and engineering-first titles
- 09:30: seed two personalized emails (short + value prop)

TODAY TASKS (check as done):
[ ] triage 40 new leads from import
[ ] make first-pass calls (20 companies)
[ ] leave targeted VMs for undecided/international (3 templates)
[ ] send demo invites for warm leads (2)
[ ] log call outcomes in CRM and add tags
[ ] sync with Marco at 16:30 re: AE handoffs

CALL STACK (ordered by priority)
1) Spectrum Health AI - Jordan Meyers (Head of ML Ops) - PT - last touch: 2026-08-12 (trial ingestion)
   - Why: trial showed heavy decoder usage; potential Dedicated fit for latency SLAs
   - Script bullets: "Hey Jordan, saw your trial spikes — curious if latency/cost were blockers? Redwood can pin model versions and route low-latency traffic. Can I get 15 mins to show cost breakdown?"
   - VM line: "Jordan, Elsa at Redwood — quick note: I have a one-page on cutting per-token cost 30% with prefix caching, can I send?"
   - Next step: email with cost snapshot (attach dummy numbers) + propose Tue 10am PT
   - CRM tag: trial-high-eng

2) NovaAPI Labs - Priya Raman (CTO) - IST - last touch: cold list
   - Why: core product integrates embeddings heavily; large monthly tokens
   - Script bullets: "Priya — quick intro, we help infra teams reduce inference variability when load spikes. Small config changes can save ~$X/month. 15 minute call?"
   - VM line: leave the short hook + email follow-up
   - Next step: send one-pager focused on Dedicated + routing policies
   - CRM tag: embeddings-heavy

3) Aster Retail - Marcus Holt (Director Eng) - CET - last touch: demo 2026-07-30 (no follow-up)
   - Why: demo good, budget pinged but stakeholder alignment unclear
   - Script bullets: "Marcus — re: last demo, any questions on rollout/ops? We can do a canary with auto-fallback to hosted to reduce risk."
   - Next step: ask for decision timeline, offer quick canary plan doc
   - CRM tag: demo-warm

4) BrightDocs - Tina Alvarez (Product Lead) - ET - last touch: email 2026-08-19 (no reply)
   - Script bullets: quick probe re: regulatory compliance needs (Private/VPC)
   - Next step: leave VM & follow-up email with one-pager on Private deployments

5) Fathom Games - Dev Ops (Inbound) - PT - last touch: inbound form 2026-08-21
   - Why: small infra team, aggressive latency goals, likely self-serve first
   - Script: rapid qualification (expected qps, peak seq len, model type)
   - Next: offer 20 min technical walkthrough; loop in SE if positive

QUICK VOICEMAIL TEMPLATES (rotate to avoid sounding scripted)
- Short VM A (10s): "Hi <Name>, Elsa Park at Redwood. Quick note — we helped a similar team cut inference cost 26% while improving p95 latency. Emailing details now."
- Short VM B (12s): "Hi <Name>, Elsa from Redwood. Got a quick idea on reducing token spend for your embedding pipeline. Drop me a time that works."
- Callback ask: always leave two time options in email follow-up.

EMAIL SUBJECT / OPENERS (pick 1)
- Subject: "Quick: inference cost + latency for <Company>"
- Opener: "Hi <Name>, I looked at your job board + product pages — looks like you run a lot of embeddings and chat endpoints. A quick note on how teams like yours shave cost while keeping p95s low."

TEMPLATE FOLLOW-UP EMAIL (short)
Hi <Name>,
Quick follow-up — we spun up a short analysis for teams using open LLMs + caching that shows a few levers to reduce token spend (batching, prefix caching, quantization profiles). Would you be open to 20 minutes Tues or Wed?
Best,
Elsa

DAILY NOTES / LEARNINGS
- Trials often stall at "ops concerns" — highlight Private/Dedicated + simple canary plan earlier.
- Technical founders respond better to numbers (X tokens saved, p95 improvement). Prep a one-pager with 3 scenarios.
- Timezones: block 09:30-11:00 PT for west-coast and 14:00-16:00 PT for EU callbacks.

AFTERNOON RITUAL (end-of-day 15m)
- update CRM notes (short bullets)
- set next-contact date for each prospect (2/5/10 day cadence)
- drop a DM in #sales-wrk to flag warm leads for SE assistance
- quick sync w/ Marco: handoff checklist if moving to AE queue

MISC SCRIPTS / REMARKS TO SELF
- When CTO asks about on-prem: lead with KMS/HSM and audit logs, avoid deep infra talk until they ask.
- If they push price: always tie back to unit economics (tokens per hour, per-feature cost).
- Use the Optimize angle: suggest quantization + batching as low-effort wins.

OPEN QUESTIONS (need answers before EOD):
- Who owns the demo environment for Aster Retail? (ask Marco)
- Is there a new Dedicated promo for Q3 that I can offer? (check with Revenue Ops)

LOOKING AHEAD: Monday playbook for next week: focus on mid-market (50-500k ARR) and embed 2 new case studies in outreach templates.

END OF NOTE
